method: Frames reviewed against each FORMA guide and equipment; only high-confidence exact-variant matches are published. Held matches stay unpublished.

clips.title: Army Combat Fitness Test- 3 Repetition Maximum Deadlift (MDL) (Event 1)
clips.author: U.S. Army (Army Combat Fitness Test)
clips.shows: Trap (hex) bar deadlift: standing inside the bar, hinge and stand to lockout.
clips.review: Hex bar clearly shown; exact match, not the straight-bar deadlift.
clips.caption: Trap (hex) bar deadlift: standing inside the bar, hinge and stand to lockout.

clips.title: Army Combat Fitness Test- Hand-Release Push-Up (HRP) (Event 3)
clips.author: U.S. Army (Army Combat Fitness Test)
clips.shows: Hand-release push-up.
clips.review: No hand-release push-up in FORMA.
clips.caption: Hand-release push-up.

clips.title: Army Combat Fitness Test- Standing Power Throw (SPT) (Event 2)
clips.author: U.S. Army (Army Combat Fitness Test)
clips.shows: Backward overhead medicine ball throw: ball lowered between the legs in a squat, then thrown back over the head.
clips.review: Backward overhead throw from a squat; not a forward overhead throw, chest pass or slam.
clips.issues: Cuts to a feet close-up; file needs remux.
clips.caption: Backward overhead medicine ball throw: ball lowered between the legs in a squat, then thrown back over the head.

clips.title: Bench press - exercise demonstration video
clips.author: FitnessScape
clips.shows: Flat barbell bench press, overhand grip, bar to mid-chest and back to lockout.
clips.review: Free barbell on a flat bench with a standard grip; not Smith, dumbbell, close-grip or powerlifting variants.
clips.issues: Burned-in 'BENCH PRESS' label from about 1 s to 6 s.
clips.caption: Flat barbell bench press, overhand grip, bar to mid-chest and back to lockout.

clips.title: Bent-over row - exercise demonstration video
clips.author: FitnessScape
clips.shows: Bent-over barbell row, overhand grip, hinge to about 45 degrees, bar to the lower ribs.
clips.review: Pronated barbell row from a hinge; not reverse-grip, Smith, dumbbell or T-bar.
clips.issues: Burned-in 'BENT-OVER ROW' label from about 1.5 s.
clips.caption: Bent-over barbell row, overhand grip, hinge to about 45 degrees, bar to the lower ribs.

clips.title: Conditional Drill- Tuck Jump
clips.author: U.S. Army (Army Combat Fitness Test)
clips.shows: Tuck jump: quarter squat, explosive vertical jump, knees driven toward the chest, soft landing.
clips.review: Matches FORMA's knee tuck jump; not a squat or broad jump.
clips.issues: Zoom cuts between reps; file needs remux.
clips.caption: Tuck jump: quarter squat, explosive vertical jump, knees driven toward the chest, soft landing.

clips.title: Conditioning Drill 1- Power Jump
clips.author: U.S. Army (Army Combat Fitness Test)
clips.shows: Deep squat with hands to the floor, then a vertical jump reaching overhead.
clips.review: FORMA's rocket jump starts from a half squat. Held.
clips.caption: Deep squat with hands to the floor, then a vertical jump reaching overhead.

clips.title: Conditioning Drill 3- Alternate Staggered Squat Jump
clips.author: U.S. Army (Army Combat Fitness Test)
clips.shows: Staggered-stance squat with a hand touch, jumping to switch feet.
clips.review: Not the deep-lunge split or scissors jump in FORMA.
clips.caption: Staggered-stance squat with a hand touch, jumping to switch feet.

clips.title: Conditioning Drill- Eight Count T Push-Up
clips.author: U.S. Army (Army Combat Fitness Test)
clips.shows: Army eight-count T push-up drill.
clips.review: No eight-count T push-up in FORMA.
clips.caption: Army eight-count T push-up drill.

clips.title: Deadlift - exercise demonstration video
clips.author: FitnessScape
clips.shows: Conventional barbell deadlift, shoulder-width stance, double-overhand grip, to standing lockout.
clips.review: Conventional stance, straight bar; not sumo, Romanian, stiff-leg or trap-bar. Mixed-grip wger entry excluded.
clips.issues: Burned-in 'DEADLIFT' label; bar starts at the rack base.
clips.caption: Conventional barbell deadlift, shoulder-width stance, double-overhand grip, to standing lockout.

clips.title: Free Weight Training Assistive Exercise- Assistive Sumo Deadlift
clips.author: U.S. Army (Army Combat Fitness Test)
clips.shows: Barbell sumo deadlift setup and lift; the video also cuts to kettlebell and dumbbell variants.
clips.review: Barbell window shows mostly setup and a brief lockout. Held.
clips.caption: Barbell sumo deadlift setup and lift; the video also cuts to kettlebell and dumbbell variants.

clips.title: Get Fit- Proper Pull-Up Technique, Marine Corps Air Station, Iwakuni, Japan 2026 (No Graphic) (1017408)
clips.author: U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Andrew Knight
clips.shows: Overhand pull-ups from a dead hang on an outdoor bar.
clips.review: Some reps partial or swinging; FitnessScape clip already covers this exercise. Held.
clips.caption: Overhand pull-ups from a dead hang on an outdoor bar.

clips.title: Hanging crunches - exercise demonstration video
clips.author: FitnessScape
clips.shows: Hanging knee tuck from a pull-up bar, knees to about hip height.
clips.review: No FORMA hanging crunch; nearest is a bent-knee knee raise, wording differs. Held.
clips.issues: Shallow knee drive; label clipped at edges.
clips.caption: Hanging knee tuck from a pull-up bar, knees to about hip height.

clips.title: Hip Sled - How to perform a 45 degree leg press
clips.author: FitnessScape
clips.shows: 45-degree plate-loaded leg press: feet on the platform, pressing the sled away and back.
clips.review: Seated reclined 45-degree sled; matches FORMA Leg press (Machine). Clip also contains a calf press segment (67.5-74 s) and a hack squat (medium).
clips.issues: Body-Solid branding on the machine; 'LEG PRESS' label about 54-58 s; slow shallow reps.
clips.caption: 45-degree plate-loaded leg press: feet on the platform, pressing the sled away and back.

clips.title: How to do a T-Bar Row in strength training workouts
clips.author: FitnessScape
clips.shows: Floor-pivot T-bar row with a V-handle, standing bent over, chest unsupported.
clips.review: Movement matches but it is a dedicated machine while FORMA lists Barbell. Held.
clips.issues: Heavy product overlays outside the trim.
clips.caption: Floor-pivot T-bar row with a V-handle, standing bent over, chest unsupported.

clips.caption: Incline barbell bench press, medium overhand grip, bar to upper chest and back to lockout.

clips.caption: Hanging straight-leg raise to about 90 degrees.
